note: Flights of stairs that are generated rather than downloaded (RM-008 F3).
Kept out of catalog.json for the same reason openings.json is: that file
is the list of model FILES this build ships, six suites assert exactly
that over it, and a generated flight has no file.
These supersede the four stair meshes in catalog.json rather than
replacing them. RM-009 U-3 measured those arriving 5.5 m wide and 4 m
tall, because every model under two units across is multiplied by 300 on
load; fixing the multiplier is RM-007 J1's and a generated flight does
not go near it. The rows stay; there is now something else to reach for.
Each row states only what differs from the defaults in items/stair.js -
16 treads at 175 x 250 mm, 900 wide, rail on the right.
